description: Read a VaneUI docs page. With only `slug` it returns the page's intro and the list of its sections; with `section` it returns that section in full, code examples included. Call search_docs first when you do not know which page or section holds the answer: each of its results has the `slug` and `section` to pass here. Component pages (`button`, `modal`, `field`, ...) hold what get_component_props does not list: value props such as `open` and `onClose` or `label` and `error`, sub-components and examples.

section.description: Section id from the page's section list or from a search_docs result, or the heading text. Leave out for the intro and the section list.

slug.description: Page slug, e.g. `modal` or `theme-defaults`. Case, a `.md` ending and a path before the name are ignored, so a component name (`IconButton`), a resource URI or a docs link (`/docs/overlay-components/modal#sizes`) works too.

name: get_doc
